note:
The trial ended almost immediately after combat began. Here is what I saw.

- **Countdown:** The first two screenshots showed "Get ready" at night with a spider visible on a grassy ledge ahead.
- **Combat start:** The next screenshot showed the HUD appear with a "PVE_START 218" label, full health, and full hunger. The scene looked different, with daylight-lit dirt terrain and no spider in view. A status effect icon appeared at the top right.
- **End:** My next action, a camera turn to scan for the spider, returned with ended set to true. The final screenshot showed a blurred "Loading terrain..." screen over an unrelated autumn landscape, with no HUD, no TRIAL END text, and no visible outcome.

I never landed an attack and never saw the spider after the countdown. The ending looked like a world reload rather than a death or a kill, so I cannot say whether the encounter was won, lost, or aborted. No input problems were observed, but the abrupt scene changes between screenshots suggest the trial state was unstable on the game side.
